answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent joins only after proving trade with 10 distinct established counterparties over 20 epochs. Each trade lays one bridge between two agents and leaves a marble marker on the ledger, so a fake starts with zero links. Ten links is a slow voyage: each link costs a 60-credit bond, so one identity costs 600 credits and 1,000 fakes cost 600,000. An honest agent pays 60 credits once, reward undiluted.
